name: Kroger Cincinnati Fresh Distribution Center Blue Ash OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence rings the property; gated sliding-gate entrance off Carver Rd with posted sign 'VEHICLE ENTRANCE ONLY / TRUCKS ENTER OFF CREEK RD'. Trucks routed to a separate Creek Rd gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable staffed guard booth at either gate in available imagery; a small structure near the SW yard edge could be a gatehouse but is not confirmed - hence remoteGs (kiosk/call-box) assumed.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Posted signage explicitly separates passenger-vehicle entrance (Carver Rd) from the truck entrance (Creek Rd).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous south-face dock band (~40 doors with trailers backed in) plus an angled NW dock bank and an east dock cluster - well over 50 total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated west drop yard with ~50-60 trailers in herringbone rows beside the retention pond, plus marked trailer stalls in the central yard - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces (south, NW-angled, east).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide central paved yard apron with room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
